g.text: A stable W3 integral does not imply converged F36 fields. All registered checks, including unplotted rows, are supplied in SOURCE_DATA.
Surface-gain tolerance: 2%; plotted flux/volume tolerance: 5%. Vertical diagnostics retain the original registered depth interpolation.
Core descent: Darcy speed >1e-8 m/s; onset requires three consecutive 10-min frames. It is not a linear-instability or MRI-detection onset.
Filled/open markers in a indicate within/outside the working tolerance; phase/amplitude sensitivity is not solver failure.
